sn47.19:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sumbhesu viharati Sedakaṃ nāma Sumbhānaṃ nigamo || || 2.
sn47.19:1.3: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave caṇḍālavaṃsiko caṇḍālavaṃsam ussāpetvā Medakathālikam antevāsim āmantesi ||
sn47.19:1.4: Ehi tvaṃ samma Medakathālike Caṇḍālavaṃsam abhirūhitvā mama uparikhandhe titthāhī ti ||
sn47.19:1.5: Evam ācariyā ti kho bhikkhave Medakathālikā antevāsī Caṇḍālavaṃsikassa paṭissutvā Caṇḍālavaṃsam abhirūhitvā ācariyassa uparikhandhe aṭṭhāsi || || 3.
sn47.19:1.6: Atha kho bhikkhave Caṇḍālavaṃsiko Medakathālikam antevāsim etad avoca ||
sn47.19:1.7: Tvaṃ samma Medakathālike mamaṃ rakkha aham tvaṃ rakkhissāmi
sn47.19:1.8: evaṃ mayam aññamaññaguttā aññamaññarakkhitā sippāni ceva dassessāma lābhañ ca lacchāma sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṃsam orohissāmā ti || || 4.
sn47.19:1.9: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Medakathālikā antevāsī Caṇḍālavaṃsikam etad avoca || ||
sn47.19:1.10: Na kho panetam ācariya evam bhavissati ||
sn47.19:1.11: tvam ācariya attānaṃ rakkha aham attanaṃ rakkhissāmi || ||
sn47.19:1.12: Evam mayam attaguttā attarakkhitā sippāni ceva dassessāma lābhañca lacchāma sotthinā ca caṇḍalavaṃsā orohissāmā ti || ||
sn47.19:2.1: So tattha ñāyo ti || || 5. Bhagavā avoca || || Yathā Medakathālikā antevāsī ācariyam avoca ||
sn47.19:2.2: Attānam bhikkhave rakkhissāmī ti satipaṭṭhānaṃ sevitabbaṃ ||
sn47.19:2.4: Attānam bhikkhave rakkhanto paraṃ rakkhati || paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati || || 6.
sn47.19:3.1: Kathañca bhikkhave attānam rakkhanto param rakkhati ||
sn47.19:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave attānaṃ rakkhanto paraṃ rakkhati || || 7.
sn47.19:3.4: Kathañca bhikkhave paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati ||
sn47.19:3.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati || || 8.
sn47.19:3.7: Attānaṃ bhikkhave rakkhissāmī ti satipaṭṭhānaṃ sevitabbam ||
sn47.19:3.9: attānam bhikkhave rakkhanto paraṃ rakkhati || paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhatī
